name: runtime-requirements-and-data-isolation
changes: Added ModuleRequirementValidator to compare declared runtime I/O requirements against requested capabilities and scoped service availability.
Integrated runtime requirement validation into ModuleManager activation before module factory resolution.
Extended capability-scoped service resolution to deny unknown module-scope service types instead of exposing inner services by default.
Added scoped storage, secure storage, and file export wrappers that namespace module keys and filenames.
Rejected empty, traversal, separator, device-name, control-character, and trailing-space/dot caller keys for scoped persistence and export services.
Mapped shared_database, authentication, diagnostics, api, security, and crypto_utilities I/O kinds to module-scoped service contracts.
testsAdded: Scoped storage resolves through a module wrapper when storage capability is granted.
Module activation validates required runtime I/O providers before factory resolution.

validation.command: python3 JSON parse over repository JSON files
rg old lifecycle and stale themeMask patterns

knownLimitations: Native compile and test execution still require Windows/MSVC, CMake, CTest, vcpkg, and PowerShell.
Secure storage and file export wrapper behavior is implemented but awaits native test execution.
